question: Marathi, which is an Indo-Aryan language, is the ________ largest language spoken by 6.86% of the total population of India according to the 2011 census.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Third**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Marathi** is the Third largest language spoken in India, according to the 2011 census.
 
• It is an Indo-Aryan language with a significant number of speakers, accounting for **6.86%** of the total population of India.
 
• The language holds a vital place in the cultural and linguistic diversity of India.
 
• Marathi is predominantly spoken in the state of Maharashtra, but it is also used in other regions of the country.
 
• As a major language, it contributes to the rich linguistic heritage of India, which is home to several languages and dialects.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• According to the 2011 census, the total number of Marathi speakers in India is approximately **83 million**.
 
• Marathi has a rich literary tradition and has produced several notable authors, poets, and playwrights.
 
• The language has its own script, known as the **Devanagari script**, which is also used for writing Hindi and Sanskrit.
 
• Marathi is one of the 22 scheduled languages of India, recognized in the Eighth Schedule of the Indian Constitution.
 
• The state government of Maharashtra actively promotes the use and development of the Marathi language through various cultural and educational initiatives.
